title: 5e-8: semantic diff for review
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

Semantic diff using HRR vectors — detect when a small text change causes a large structural shape change. Four-quadrant classification model:

| | Small HRR Δ | Large HRR Δ |
|---|---|---|
| Small text Δ | Trivial | **Subtle structural change — flag** |
| Large text Δ | Safe refactoring | Major rewrite (expected) |

- similarity/diff.rs: compare before/after strip vectors (cosine similarity) against text diff size (lines changed). Classify into quadrants. Emit hrr_shape_change HealthFinding for the top-right quadrant (small text, large structural).
- Review integration: hrr_shape_change findings appear in sutra_review output.
- "Before" vectors: from the previous parse or from git (parse the pre-change version of modified files).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] similarity/diff.rs with four-quadrant classification
- [ ] hrr_shape_change finding emitted for subtle structural changes (small text Δ + large HRR Δ)
- [ ] Configurable thresholds for text-Δ and HRR-Δ boundaries
- [ ] Integrated into sutra_review output
- [ ] Tests: quadrant classification correctness — given vector pairs and text diff sizes, verify correct quadrant selection and finding emission

## Blocked by

- sutra/84 (5e-1: health finding model)
- sutra/88 (5e-4: HRR encoder)
- sutra/92 (5e-review-2: checkpoint 2 quality gate)"
implementation_plan:
1. git_file_content_at in src/git.rs — retrieves old file content via git show
2. src/similarity/diff.rs — core module: ShapeChangeConfig, DiffQuadrant, detect_shape_changes, shape_changes_to_findings
3. Integration in src/tools/review.rs — extracts base revision, calls shape detection, adds hrr_shape_changes to output JSON
4. 8 unit tests passing (quadrant classification, text delta, finding conversion)
execution_record:
Pipeline verified end-to-end:
- git_file_content_at correctly retrieves old source
- extract_functions finds function nodes in tree-sitter trees
- HRR strip vectors computed and compared via cosine_similarity
- Four-quadrant classification works correctly
- Review integration: hrr_shape_changes JSON section emitted for SubtleStructural findings
- Live test with permissive thresholds confirmed full pipeline: 7 functions detected in search.rs, find_similar classified as subtle_structural (text=0.759, hrr=0.126)

Calibration note: default thresholds (text≤0.15, hrr≥0.40) are conservative. Whole-function HRR comparison dilutes small changes (1 line in 15 → hrr_delta=0.035). May need threshold tuning or sub-function comparison in a follow-up.
